name: Geometry Island - Shapes, Symmetry & Spatial Lab
description: Interactive spatial lab for perimeter calculation, unit square grid area counting, lines of symmetry, 3D cube stacks, and angle exploration across the 5-stage mastery model.
author: TezMindz Olympiad Team

stages.name: Concept Discovery
stages.focus: Walk along polygon boundaries and tile unit squares, observe perimeter vs. area distinction

stages.name: Guided Simulation
stages.focus: Calculate unknown perimeter, side length, or symmetry line with 4-tier hints

stages.name: Rule Discovery
stages.focus: Formulate perimeter formulas: Rectangle P = 2(L + B), Square P = 4S

stages.name: Controlled Practice
stages.focus: Dynamic variations across rectangles, triangles, L-shaped composite figures, and grids

stages.name: Anti-Memorisation Assessment
stages.focus: Unseen word problem about boundary fencing or carpet tiling without canvas visual

sampleData.prompt: An architect on Geometry Island is enclosing a park with length 16 m and breadth 7 m. What is the total perimeter fence needed?
sampleData.subPrompt: Trace all four boundary sides of the rectangle.
progressiveHints: Level 1 (Attention): Perimeter is the total continuous path around the boundary of the 2D polygon.
Level 2 (Reasoning): A rectangle has 2 equal lengths (16 m each) and 2 equal widths (7 m each).
Level 4 (Full Solution): 16 + 7 = 23. 2 × 23 = 46 m. The perimeter fence required is 46 m.
